info.name: MediDropBox API Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for MediDropBox - Hospital and Doctor Management System

**Key Features:**
- OTP-based patient authentication (phone + last 4 digits as OTP)
- Three-layer patient identity model (GlobalPatient + HospitalPatient)
- Cross-hospital booking retrieval for patients
- Hospital-scoped patient management
- Role-based access control (RBAC)
- Patient identity documents (Aadhar ID, ABHA ID)
- Patient address management
- Emergency contacts with person name list
- Payment integration with booking (optional transaction ID)
- Consent-based data sharing (privacy-first approach)
- Lab report management with AWS S3 storage
- Permission-based report access for doctors
- Encrypted sensitive data (AI summary, notes)

**Authentication:**
- Staff/Admin: Username + Password login
- Patients: Phone + OTP (last 4 digits of phone number)

**Patient Fields:**
- Basic: fullName, phone, email, profileImageUrl
- Identity: aadharId (12 digits), abhaId (ABHA Health ID)
- Address: addressLine1, addressLine2, city, state, country, pincode, latitude, longitude, locationUrl
- Emergency Contacts: personName, phone, relationship, email, isPrimary

**Data Consent (Privacy-First):**
- When booking: `dataConsent: true` copies full data (address, Aadhar, ABHA, emergency contacts) from GlobalPatient to HospitalPatient
- `dataConsent: false` or omitted: Only basic data (name, phone, email) saved in HospitalPatient
- Patient can give consent later - existing HospitalPatient will be updated with full data
- Each hospital maintains separate patient records with consent tracking

**Payment Details:**
- Payment can be included during booking creation or added separately later
- Payment Modes: CASH, CARD, UPI, NET_BANKING, WALLET
- Payment Fields: paymentMode, totalBill, totalAmount, discount, taxableAmount, gst, transactionId (optional)
- Transaction ID: Optional field for payment gateway transaction reference (e.g., UPI transaction ID, card transaction ID)

item.name: Booking Management

request.description:
Create a new booking (PATIENT only). Uses global patient ID from authenticated user. Queue is automatically created.

**Data Consent:**
- `dataConsent: true` - Full patient data (address, Aadhar, ABHA, emergency contacts) will be copied from GlobalPatient to HospitalPatient
- `dataConsent: false` or omitted - Only basic data (name, phone, email) will be saved in HospitalPatient

**Payment:** Payment details are optional - if provided, payment will be created and linked to booking. Payment can also be created separately later if not provided during booking.

Create a new booking for a patient (HOSPITAL_ADMIN/STAFF only). Requires phoneNumber. Creates/get hospital patient if needed.

**Data Consent:**
- `dataConsent: true` - Full patient data (address, Aadhar, ABHA, emergency contacts) will be copied from GlobalPatient to HospitalPatient
- `dataConsent: false` or omitted - Only basic data (name, phone, email) will be saved in HospitalPatient

**Payment:** Payment details are optional - if provided, payment will be created and linked to booking. Payment can also be created separately later if not provided during booking.
Get ALL bookings for the current patient across ALL hospitals (cross-hospital query, PATIENT only)
Get all bookings for a hospital (HOSPITAL_ADMIN/HOSPITAL_STAFF/ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only)
Get all bookings for a doctor (HOSPITAL_ADMIN/HOSPITAL_STAFF/DOCTOR/ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only)
Get booking details with role-based filtering

item.description: Booking management endpoints. Bookings link to both GlobalPatient (for cross-hospital queries) and HospitalPatient (for hospital-scoped queries). Patient self-booking uses globalPatientId from authenticated user. Hospital staff booking uses phoneNumber to create/get HospitalPatient.

item.name: OTP Authentication

request.description: Generate OTP for phone number. Currently hardcoded: OTP is last 4 digits of phone number. For phone +91-9876543210, OTP is 3210.

Verify OTP and get JWT tokens. If patient doesn't exist, will be created. If UNCLAIMED, will be claimed. OTP is last 4 digits of phone number. Automatically saves accessToken and refreshToken to environment.

request.description:
Update HospitalPatient record by HospitalPatient ID (HOSPITAL_ADMIN can only update their own hospital patients). Only provided fields will be updated (partial update). This updates the hospital-specific patient record.

**Fields that can be updated:**
- Basic: fullName, phone, email, profileImageUrl
- Identity: aadharId, abhaId
- Address: Complete address object (addressLine1, addressLine2, city, state, country, pincode, latitude, longitude, locationUrl)
- Emergency Contacts: List of emergency contacts (personName, phone, relationship, email, isPrimary)

**Note:** If patient gives consent later (via booking with dataConsent: true), full data will be automatically copied from GlobalPatient.
Deactivate a HospitalPatient by HospitalPatient ID (HOSPITAL_ADMIN can only deactivate their own hospital patients). This deactivates the hospital-specific patient record, not the global patient.
Get reports for a patient uploaded by this hospital only. HOSPITAL_ADMIN/HOSPITAL_STAFF see only reports their hospital uploaded. (hospitalPatientId = hospital patient ID)
Upload a report for a patient (hospital staff). Report is linked to this hospital. Multipart: file, reportType, reportDate, doctorName (optional), labName (optional).

item.name: Doctor Lab Reports

request.description:
Get all lab reports for a patient by entering patient ID (global patient ID). Requires permission from patient. Doctor must have been granted access by the patient. (DOCTOR/HOSPITAL_ADMIN/HOSPITAL_STAFF only)

**How to use:**
1. Patient grants permission via "Grant Permission" endpoint
2. Doctor enters patient's global patient ID
3. System checks if doctor has permission
4. If granted, returns all accessible reports

**Error:** If permission not granted, returns 403 Forbidden with message: "You don't have permission to view this patient's reports. Please ask the patient to grant permission from the app."
